nodes.value: Separate immutable policy/authority rules from editable prompting.
Bind each prompt/instruction version to intended model/capability and regression evidence.
Pin model/config/tool context for comparative prompt tests.
Track quality/safety/cost changes and nondeterminism envelopes.
Routing rules must encode capability/privacy/cost/reliability constraints explicitly.
Policy must distinguish authoritative, inferred and user-editable memory.
Deletion/tombstone semantics survive compaction and restore.
Refresh must not overwrite history required for temporal queries.
Index/projection refresh is atomic or explicitly resumable.
Every time-sensitive claim supports scope/validity intervals where known.
Corrections supersede without erasing historical lineage.
Do not convert missing evidence into numeric confidence by default.
Preserve competing hypotheses until evidence resolves them.
Separate hypothesis plausibility from verified fact.
Interventions/simulations cannot be reported as observed facts.
Search fanout/depth is bounded and observable.
Use explicit cost/risk/time and uncertainty inputs.
Stop conditions are explicit and externally enforceable.
High-risk unresolved uncertainty can force abstain/escalate rather than output.
Use independent evidence/checks for high-impact outputs.
Quality gates vary by artifact type/change impact.
Artifact version under test must match published artifact.
Human approval records exact proposed action/evidence/version.
Material action changes invalidate prior approval.
Use topology/dependency/tenant scope rather than textual guess only.
Cap or require approval above declared thresholds.
Budget is evaluated before and during mutation.
Exceeding budget pauses/escalates rather than silently expanding scope.
Migrations are resumable/idempotent or explicitly atomic.
Mixed-version and rollback behavior declared before activation.
Legacy compatibility must not create second authority.
Adapter removal requires consumer inventory and migration proof.
Deprecation state is versioned and machine-readable.
Removal blocked while supported consumers remain unless explicitly broken by policy.
Preserve provenance and uncertainty of inferred intent.
Do not promote archaeological inference into authority without confirmation/evidence.
Consolidation must declare source/destination owner and compatibility strategy.
No source retirement before import inversion and affected-domain evidence.
Preserve imported/generated code source identity and licensing metadata.
Refactors retain lineage links to predecessors.
Differentiate intentional adapters/generated mirrors from accidental duplication.
Use ownership/dependency evidence before proposing removal.
Every production module has one canonical ownership zone.
Ownership changes preserve history and dependency impact.
Generated rules are deterministic and reviewable.
Security/authority paths can require additional fixed reviewers.
Documentation references to contracts/paths are validated.
Normative docs identify their authority/source relationship.
Manual diagrams cannot silently override machine topology.
Snapshot includes machine manifests and relevant dependency graph identities.
Allow compare/diff across snapshots for drift analysis.
Investigate unexplained binary differences before promotion.
Fail or explicitly vendor/cache network dependencies for qualified builds.
Sensitive/tenant-specific data cannot enter shared cache.
Verification is required before install/deploy where policy applies.
Defend path/symlink/archive traversal and permission mistakes.
Define authorized rollback separately from malicious downgrade.
Recovery path has fewer dependencies than normal bootstrap.
Validate repaired artifacts before handing control to full runtime.
Crash collection must survive partial subsystem failure.
Bundle contents are allowlisted/classified, not arbitrary filesystem dumps.
